label: Badminton — before (old default)
note: The stress scene: hair visibly broken. Seed 1234, alpha-fix ON — the recipe that shipped until 2026-08-07. Hair-band alpha 0.927 mean, 6 frames below the 0.85 bar. Orbit behind the head and watch the ponytail.

label: Badminton — after (ADR-021 default)
note: Same fit, one config change: opacity-decay floor 0.996/0.998 → 0.999/0.9995. Hair +0.0133 across 3 seeds (CI excludes 0), masked PSNR +0.199 dB, 98.3% of frames improving. Camera pose is kept when you switch — the difference is the hair, not the view.

label: Dance — before (old default)
note: The precision scene: hair already good (0.977 mean, zero failing frames). Seed 2025 control — the harder case for any hair lever, because there is little headroom left.

label: Dance — after (ADR-021 default)
note: The adopted default on the precision scene: hair +0.0056 (3/3 seeds, 92.8% of frames), masked PSNR +0.054 dB. Real but ~3× smaller than badminton — the effect is proportional to the headroom available.

label: Dance — default + split_preserve (opt-in)
note: The un-shelved lever stacked on the default: +0.131 dB masked PSNR vs control, hair statistically level with the default alone. Opt-in, not default — it is still mildly costly on the very worst frames.
